sentences.japanese: ウサギには長い耳と短い尾がある。
sentences.english: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.

sentences.japanese: 魚は尾を動かして泳ぐ。
sentences.english: A fish swims by moving its tail.

sentences.japanese: ライオンの尾となる犬より犬の頭となるほうがいい。
sentences.english: Better to be the head of a dog than the tail of a lion.

sentences.japanese: それは女性の頭、ライオンの胴体、鳥の翼とヘビの尾を持っていた。
sentences.english: It had the head of a woman, the body of a lion, the wings of a bird, and the tail of a serpent.

sentences.japanese: その少年はその犬の尾をつかんだ。
sentences.english: The boy caught the dog by the tail.
